recipe: Reconcile current authority, public repository, exact synthetic branch/head and the historical workflow before any new run. The old audit files remain immutable donors.
Use a new namespaced synthetic branch only if a separately current Work needs a rerun. Record branch/head, possible workflow run/artifacts/status effect, plan and receipts before execution.
GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows matrix with contents:read, credential persistence disabled, pinned Actions and bounded job timeout; compare small payload bytes after download.
Treat public contents GET=200 as bounded positive read, and status POST=403 as bounded negative write. Any unexpected write success is failure evidence and stops dependent execution.
Persist compact payloads/digests and exact run/artifact/head pointers before expiry. Record cleanup/readback before any retry.

possible_resources: unexpected commit status if the negative write probe succeeds
cleanup.actions: Expected historical write was denied, so no status was created. Preserve compact Git payloads. Artifacts expire after seven days. For a future authorized rerun remove only its owned synthetic branch after durable receipts. Commit statuses cannot be erased through an invented delete operation; keep unexpected status and failure receipt visible, no history rewrite.
cleanup.replay: UNKNOWN run/POST result requires exact run/head/status live-read before retry; never blind-replay a possibly successful POST.
cleanup.durable_receipt_before_retry: Current Work checkpoint with exact head/run/known resources, last result, UNKNOWN reconciliation and residual cleanup.
